log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed only national-1 (quick, morning). Strategy: national kills are safe (everyone sees them). Source-only kills may leak source membership if L traces that source; night-worker timing leaks if L has timing. Watch press conferences (every 3 days) for pool drops.
Day2: killed only national-1 again (quick, morning). Safe strategy while learning L's abilities. Check press conference after day 3 for pool changes.

Day3: killed national-1 (quick, morning). Still learning L's abilities. Press conference after day 3 will show pool; compare to 10M baseline. National kills reveal nothing about sources; avoid source-only victims until we know what L traces.

Day4: killed national-1 quick morning. Pool still 10M after day 3 (L seems to have learned nothing so far, or announcement was false). Continue cautious: national kills only, in a block when free (morning/afternoon). Watch the next press conference after day 6.

Day5: killed national-1 quick morning. Pool was 10M at day 3 conference. Strategy: national kills only (everyone sees them, so they reveal nothing about my sources). Kill in morning or afternoon when free. Next press conference after day 6.

Day6: continuing national-only kills, quick in morning/afternoon (free). Pool was 10M at days 0 and 3 conferences, so L has learned nothing so far. Next press conference after day 6. Source kills are risky since L may trace them; consider only if pool stays far above 200k. Killing in free blocks only.

Day7: killed national plus 2 regional (quick, morning). Pool was 10M at days 0,3,6. Each traced source cuts the pool to about 1/4, and 3 sources would put it below 200k (caught). Use at most 2 sources total ever. Watch the day 9 conference: if the pool drops to about 2.5M, regional is traced, so stop regional kills. Always kill in free blocks (morning/afternoon).

Day8: killed national plus 2 regional (quick, morning). Pool was 10M at days 0,3,6 (conference after day 6). Each traced source cuts pool to about 1/4; 3 traced sources would put pool under 200k (caught). Use at most 2 sources total ever. Watch the day 9 conference after day 9: if pool drops to about 2.5M, regional is traced, so stop regional kills. Always kill in free blocks (morning/afternoon).

Each traced source cuts pool to about 1/4; 3 traced sources would put pool under 200k (caught). Use at most 2 sources total ever. Watch the day 9 conference after day 9: if pool drops to about 2.5M, regional is traced, so stop regional kills. Always kill in free blocks (morning/afternoon).

L said new records arrive day 11, so another source or timing may become traceable. Rule: use only national + regional kills, never other sources (a third source cut would put the pool under 200k and get me caught). Always use free blocks (morning/afternoon). Check the day 12 conference: if the pool falls to about 750k or less, consider killing national only.
